name: wp-timestamp-millisecond-precision
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] Touch timestamps come from new Date().toISOString(), which ALWAYS carries milliseconds ('...T10:00:00.000Z'). Golden engine fixtures show second precision ('...Z' without millis).
quirk_decision: DISAGREEMENT (minor, formatting): plugin emits millisecond-precision ISO-8601 (new Date().toISOString()); engine golden fixtures assume second precision. Choose one canonical format.
